    - *democratic source* — Custodial execution is one of six constitutionally distinct Class 6 protective mandates, each of which needs its own democratic source, enumerated mandate, trigger, scope, conflict and recusal rule, non-delegable limit, review, appeal, end condition, and temporal status, and every protective function is under civilian, democratically sourced command. This function holds no self-originating authority at all: its source is the court's order, and its mandate is to hold a person a court has lawfully ordered held.
    - *jurisdiction* — The reach is exactly the confinement one court order authorises and no further: this function may not decide the ground, extend the authority, or supply its own review, and it carries no policing, prosecution, adjudication, intelligence, or surveillance mandate. Inside that reach the person retains the complete floor, voice, franchise, candidacy, and every liberty not necessarily incident to the lawful ground of holding, and anyone the state physically holds is owed shelter and a recorded voice. Where the instrument holds a person convicted of nothing, it is a separate instrument with a separate trigger, separate evidence, separate review, and a separate temporal contract, and it is never punishment: it may not attach a punitive consequence of any kind or be recorded as, presented as, or reasoned from as a conviction. That last limit is categorical rather than a limit on acting alone, and this card says so because the check-line phrasing could be read the other way: no second body's concurrence makes punishing an unconvicted person lawful.
    - *ordinary function* — The ordinary day is custody without incident, and the card shows it rather than only the failure: housing the person a court has lawfully ordered held, keeping their words on a record that some independent reader can reach, keeping their floor, care, and access to counsel and to a chosen representative intact, and keeping the record of who is held, by whom, and on what ground reachable by an independent body and by that representative. Contact is owed on the family ruling's terms rather than on this administration's: imprisonment, institutional placement, disability, migration status, or household form never automatically ends parentage, contact, custody, or the child's relationship rights, and a restriction requires an individualized lawful basis, necessity, proportionality, the child's voice, review, continuity, and remedy. Anyone the state physically holds is owed shelter and a recorded voice, so provision and record-keeping are the day job and force is the exception, lawful only where it is strictly necessary, where no reasonably available less harmful means would serve, and only as the minimum sufficient, stopping the moment its purpose is achieved; where current authority for the holding is absent, the conclusion that this person may be held is withheld rather than assumed.
    - *delegation boundary* — Coercive public force may not be delegated to a private actor: mercenary forces, paramilitary organisations, and private armed groups are refused, and where private security performs a lawful protective service it holds no more authority than any person holds. No secondment, joint command, shared chain of authority, unified staffing, or reserve status may reconstitute a fused police-military-intelligence force out of separated mandates, and this function may not decide the ground, extend the authority, or supply its own review.
    - *conflict and recusal* — The separating rule is the general one applied without modification: no actor may assert decisive case facts, decide their consequence, execute the result, audit itself, and supply the final remedy in the same case. Every death, life-threatening injury, and credible allegation of torture or disappearance involving a protective actor requires prompt, independent, effective investigation by a body other than the deploying body. Beyond those walls the controlling ruling supplies no recusal rule for a custodial officer, so the general requirement that every office carry conflict and recusal rules governs, and this card records the absent doctrine rather than writing one.
    - *appointment* — The controlling ruling supplies no appointment machinery for this administration, and its protective-oversight appointment sentence binds the independent oversight body rather than the function that body examines. This is ordinary public administration executing a court's order rather than a predeclared independent office, so the ratified contract for independent appointments — open nominations, reasoned qualification review, divided appointing sources, staggered and nonrenewable mandates — is cited here as the nearest ratified pattern and expressly not as this body's rule, and the anti-capture appointment machinery is deliberately not imported for it. What governs instead is the general requirement that every office have a democratic or legal source, mandate, jurisdiction, delegation boundary, conflict and recusal rules, finite end condition, successor, review route, and public-reason duty, while future body cards must make both direct and de facto appointment control observable and allocate the exact seats, selectors, and qualification authority. The gap is recorded, not filled.
    - *removal* — No removal cause for a custodial office appears in the controlling ruling, and none is written here. The rule that mandates are staggered and nonrenewable and that removal is for stated cause after independent fact-finding and cross-body confirmation is written for independent appointments rather than for ordinary administration, so it is cited as the nearest ratified pattern and not as this body's rule; the qualifying causes for this particular office are enumerated nowhere and that silence is recorded rather than supplied. What the sources do supply is that individual accountability is personal, that rank, orders, or institutional attribution does not absorb it, and that no immunity, indemnity, classification, statute of repose, amnesty, or pardon may extinguish accountability for a categorically refused act, so a removal ends a mandate and never the answerability.
    - *succession* — A successor, a review route, and a finite end condition are owed of every office, and no required reviewer may turn silence into approval while no unavailable writer or reviewer may obtain a permanent withholding veto: every consequential route needs a predeclared alternate or escalation path with the same limits and independent review. One asymmetry is stated rather than smoothed — a vacancy withholds the power to hold and never converts into authority to keep holding — and through it the person's shelter, voice, floor, appeal, and remedy continue.
    - *temporal status* — Custody is the one power whose case-bound temporal contract is already implemented: Book 1 specifies those fields for the Court custody family — its reviewed authority; exact case, person, Court judgment, and injury victim; canonical current source and record; a supplied challenge route; and fail-closed consequence for the restrictive power. The controlling protective ruling adds no new contract for this administration and says instead that the case-bound custody contract cannot be reused or borrowed by implication, and the custody-only path may not be borrowed as an office term or an election clock, so the retained record is applied here and extended nowhere.
    - *public reason duty* — Every protective record — arrest, detention, search, seizure, use of force, surveillance authorisation, declaration, renewal, border decision, expulsion, transfer, deployment — names its authorised writer, permitted basis, visibility and privacy boundary, independent reader, reasons, challenge route, correction, retention and deletion control, carry, end condition, alternate route, continuity, remedy, audit, and failure polarity. There is no incommunicado detention, no unrecorded detention, no undisclosed place of detention, and no detention whose existence a court may not verify, and absence of a record is never proof that a coercive act did not happen and never a defence for the actor who should have written it.
    - *anti capture* — The ratified incompatibility rule names majority appointment control of a court or independent oversight body rather than an administration, and divided sources alone do not prove concentration absent; this card records that reach limit rather than stretching it. What binds this function directly is the anti-fusion wall and the private-coercion refusal read with the separation rule: no secondment or shared chain of authority may reconstitute a fused force, no private actor may hold the coercive authority, and no custodial function may audit its own holding or supply the final remedy for it.
- Accountability routes:
    - *challenge* (FS-BOD-17, FS-BOD-20, FS-ROL-34, FS-ROL-37, FS-ROL-38) — Initiation routes are plural: the affected person, a chosen supporter, a qualified association, and the rights advocate or ombud may each initiate independently, and none requires another to be present. Ordinary courts give case-specific relief, and the record of who is held, by whom, and on what ground must be reachable by an independent body and by the person's chosen representative, so the held person's own voice reaches a record rather than depending on this administration's account of it.
    - *review* (FS-BOD-17, FS-BOD-18, FS-ROL-34, FS-ROL-37) — Detention before trial requires prompt, automatic, independent judicial review that the detained person does not have to request, and repeated review thereafter; prompt independent judicial review of detention sits inside the unamendable corridor, and indefinite detention without charge or without independent review is refused categorically. Ordinary courts give case-specific relief and the Constitutional Court alone gives final general invalidation, so relief in one case and general invalidation stay in different hands.
    - *audit* (FS-BOD-19, FS-BOD-14, FS-ROL-27, FS-ROL-40) — Every protective function requires an independent oversight body with its own appointment under the ratified anti-capture contract, its own budget and staff, full access, publication power, and a defined action duty, and an independent integrity route that does not run through the abuser's own chain of command, with destruction, falsification, or non-recording of evidence of its own coercive acts treated as a substantive failure and not a procedural one. The endpoint is stated rather than obscured: the sources specify who must be able to look and what must follow, while the legal route proves no actual receipt, action, completed remedy, recurrence control, or institutional liveness, and implementation may not upgrade a specification into an assurance.
    - *political-accountability* (FS-BOD-02, FS-BOD-04, FS-ROL-25, FS-ROL-27) — Every protective function is under civilian, democratically sourced command, so the mandate, its limits, and its funding answer to elected institutions rather than to the function itself. That route reaches the mandate and never the case: civilian command may not decide the ground, extend the authority, or supply its own review, and no political direction converts into permission to hold a person the court's order does not cover.
- Individualized adverse determinations: enumerated — The ground of a holding, its consequence, and its end all belong to the court: this administration may not decide the ground, extend the authority, or supply its own review, so no general right of appeal against the office as such is created here and appeal attaches to each named determination below. One substitute route is stated at its ratified width rather than wider: the independent investigation by a body other than the deploying one is owed for every death, life-threatening injury, and credible allegation of torture or disappearance, which does not reach every use of force, restraint, or restriction inside custody, and the enumerated items carry those. The controlling ruling supplies no internal classification, discipline, or privilege determination for this function, and this card records that silence rather than inventing one.
    - **Use of force or restraint against a person the state holds** against a person physically held under the court's order against whom force or restraint is used. Appeal: Force is lawful only where it is strictly necessary for a legitimate protective purpose, where no reasonably available less harmful means would serve, and only as the minimum sufficient, and it must stop the moment its purpose is achieved; the evidential burden for the lawfulness of force is on the public actor and not on the person harmed. Every death, life-threatening injury, and credible allegation of torture or disappearance requires prompt, independent, effective investigation by a body other than the deploying body; initiation is plural, so the affected person, a chosen supporter, a qualified association, and the rights advocate or ombud may each initiate independently and none requires another to be present; and ordinary courts give case-specific relief while the Constitutional Court alone gives final general invalidation. Remedy: Every use of force creates a duty to render or obtain immediate medical aid, including to the person against whom force was used, and what is owed afterwards is a remedy that reaches the person harmed rather than only disciplining the institution. Relief for the person runs beside re-audit, redesign, recurrence monitoring, and non-repetition measures for the pattern; no remedy may take another person's standing, floor, core liberty, due process, or political equality; and no immunity, indemnity, classification, statute of repose, amnesty, or pardon may extinguish accountability for a categorically refused act.
    - **Restriction of a held person's liberty, contact, or access inside custody** against a held person whose liberty, contact, or access is restricted by the holding administration rather than by the court's order. Appeal: A person the state holds retains the complete floor, voice, franchise, candidacy, and every liberty not necessarily incident to the lawful ground of holding, and authority is withheld where the restriction is not carried by the court's order, because this administration may not decide the ground, extend the authority, or supply its own review. Contact and family relationships are not this administration's to end: imprisonment, institutional placement, disability, migration status, or household form never automatically ends parentage, contact, custody, or the child's relationship rights, and a restriction requires an individualized lawful basis, necessity, proportionality, the child's voice, review, continuity, and remedy. The record of who is held, by whom, and on what ground must be reachable by an independent body and by the person's chosen representative, initiation is plural, and ordinary courts give case-specific relief. Remedy: Anyone the state physically holds, by any instrument, is owed shelter and a recorded voice, and that is a floor non-reduction rule and an affirmative duty rather than a claim that protective restriction improves anyone's position; it does not make holding a route to the floor, and a restriction inside custody may not be worked into a reduction of either. The protective record carries its own independent reader, reasons, challenge route, and correction, absence of a record is never proof that a coercive act did not happen and never a defence for the actor who should have written it, and relief for the person runs beside re-audit, redesign, recurrence monitoring, and non-repetition measures for the pattern.
- Temporal contract (case-bound custodial holding authority under the implemented Court custody review gate; custody T3 retained-application): This is the one already implemented case-bound contract, applied here and extended nowhere: Book 1 specifies those fields for the Court custody family — its reviewed authority; exact case, person, Court judgment, and injury victim; canonical current source and record; a supplied challenge route; and fail-closed consequence for the restrictive power — and the route suspends only when its challenge fact reaches this source, which has no durable intake or alternate filing witness. The controlling protective ruling grants this administration no new contract and holds that the case-bound custody contract cannot be reused or borrowed by implication, so every other power must source its own.
    - Failure polarity: Current reviewed authority is a positive premise of holding, and the polarity is the same as the existing custody gate — its absence withholds the restrictive conclusion. No opposite fact follows from that absence: cessation is a positive recorded act or a fresh-evaluation claim and is never derived from silence, so missing, stale, disputed, or unwitnessed authority withholds the conclusion that this person may be held while establishing neither a discharge nor any physical event.
    - Expiry default: A missed renewal ends or suspends the authority unless an independent, reviewable lawful basis remains, and it never turns a claimant's missed deadline into loss of a core claim; missing, withheld, stale, disputed, or corrected evidence never extends a restrictive power and never cuts off a claimant's floor, liberty, appeal, or remedy. The floor and essential-service continuity survive the lapse of the managing authority, and that is the source-bound default this card chooses: essential claimant continuity is preserved without preserving ordinary incumbent power.
- Delegated mechanics (bounded, never an invented value):
    - The cadence of the repeated review that follows the first automatic one is reserved to constitutional implementation, and the scope of that rule is recorded rather than widened: the ruling attaches prompt, automatic, independent judicial review that the detained person does not have to request, and repeated review thereafter, to detention before trial, while what the unamendable corridor carries for detention generally is prompt independent judicial review without those two words. Neither writes an interval, calendar, or duration, because this design carries no duration arithmetic and no personal time score, and this card's own check-line is read at the narrower ratified scope rather than as a new general rule. Choice owner: constitutional implementation inside the ratified sources, anti-capture rules, democratic corridor, continuity defaults, and prohibitions, with any choice outside those limits returning for a new author ruling Bounds: review before trial must be prompt, automatic, unrequested, repeated, judicial, and independent; prompt independent judicial review of detention sits inside the unamendable corridor for every holding, without the automatic and unrequested clauses being extended there by this card; indefinite detention without charge or without independent review is refused; and no earned-time credit, severity-to-duration table, character grading, or recency label may decide a person's sentence Failure default: absent current reviewed authority the holding conclusion is withheld and no discharge or other event is derived, while the person's shelter, voice, floor, appeal, and remedy continue
- Book 2 handoff: Book 2 owns operation under ordinary and declared shock conditions for custody: facilities, transport, health and care delivery inside custody, incident command, record systems, staffing, costs, capacity, and empirical feasibility, together with clocks, calendars, witnessing, publication, storage, and recovery, and the assurance that an outside clock advances, that a required record arrives, that a reviewer actually acts, and that a person a court has ordered released physically leaves. Book 1 can withhold current legal effect from an unsupported holding; it cannot cause any of those events.

#### FS-BOD-36 — Emergency alternate authorising route (predeclared-alternate)

- Applicability: the ordinary cross-branch authorising body being unable to convene
- Status: ratified-unimplemented narrow function; severity critical; consequence: emergency alternate authorising route absent or fused with an incompatible function
- Owner: `new-book-plans/book-1-constitutional-coverage-map.md::Maintain completed constitutional coverage rows`; closure: the owning source-family power cards and allocations remain complete and source-bound
- Status senses:
    - *universal human standing* — Emergency is an overlay that suspends nothing: a declaration may accelerate procedure, redirect resources, requisition with compensation, and impose reviewable restrictions against the named hazard, and it confers no power to derogate from any categorical refusal or to lower the material floor. The route therefore confers no personhood and removes none, and formal implementation must keep universal human standing separate from political membership, franchise, candidacy, current office, current lawful power, and permanent historical public answerability.
    - *political membership* — Ordinary residence creates political membership and an emergency route neither creates nor removes it; registration records evidence of membership rather than creating it, and a declaration confers no power to alter the franchise. A person named in a declaration or affected by a measure is a person the record holds something about, never a person whose membership the record may be read to withdraw.
    - *franchise* — A declaration confers no power to postpone or cancel an election, to extend any mandate, or to alter the franchise, and the ordinary franchise is non-derogable, which no declaration suspends or postpones. This route may not weight, condition, suspend, or substitute a ballot, and the continued existence and capacity to sit of the People's Assembly sits inside the unamendable corridor beyond its reach.
    - *candidacy* — No decision supplies an express candidacy incompatibility for whoever is predeclared on this route, so the adult-resident baseline governs unchanged and the silence is recorded rather than filled. The one express separation the sources do supply is functional and not electoral: the predeclared alternate authorising route and the predeclared independent substitute reviewer are two named routes, not one, and the ratified incompatibility rule addresses majority appointment control rather than who may stand for election.
    - *current office* — What occupancy consists of here is being named in advance: the route is predeclared, bound by every limit in the emergency section, and subject to immediate ratification by the ordinary body the moment it can act. A certified successor immediately ends the predecessor's current authority and a refusal to acknowledge that certification, transfer records, or leave office does not extend the mandate, and an alternate authorisation that the ordinary body does not ratify at its first opportunity ends.
    - *current lawful power* — Authority is a positive premise carried by an exact declaration version, and the polarity is the same as the existing custody gate — current authority is a positive premise, and its absence withholds the restrictive conclusion. The overlay creates no continuing power between declarations, so between them there is nothing to withhold; and when authority is absent no opposite fact follows, because cessation is a positive recorded act or a fresh-evaluation claim and is never derived from silence.
    - *permanent historical public answerability* — Answerability for what was authorised survives every removal, reorganisation, and renaming of a body, and no immunity, indemnity, classification, statute of repose, amnesty, or pardon may extinguish accountability for a categorically refused act. The end of a declaration triggers a mandatory public post-hoc audit and an accounting of every requisition and restriction, so the historical record of what was done under it is owed after the authority itself has ended, while current office and current lawful power do end.
- Office contract:
    - *democratic source* — The ordinary source is cross-branch authorisation, so that no body declares and exercises alone. This route exists only as the ratified settlement applied to the case where that requirement hands whoever can prevent the authorising body from convening a veto over every lawful response: a predeclared alternate authorising route and a predeclared independent substitute reviewer, both named in advance, both bound by every limit in the emergency section, and both subject to immediate ratification by the ordinary body the moment it can act.
    - *jurisdiction* — The reach is exactly what a declaration confers and nothing else: procedural acceleration with every substantive protection, evidence rule, and appeal surviving; resource redirection; requisition with compensation, reasons, record, return or compensation, and challenge; and temporary, reviewable restriction against the named hazard, each separately justified. It confers no power to suspend a right, to legislate by decree, to dissolve or prevent the sitting of the Assembly, to close or bypass the courts, to postpone or cancel an election, to extend any mandate, to alter the franchise, to detain without the ordinary grounds and review, to derogate from any categorical refusal, or to lower the material floor.
    - *ordinary function* — The ordinary job of a predeclared alternate is to be predeclared and reachable, and nothing else: the overlay creates no standing power between declarations, so on an ordinary day this route holds no authority to exercise and its whole function is that it is already named. Where the ordinary authorising body cannot convene, the job is to supply only the cross-branch authorisation that body would have supplied, bound by every limit in the emergency section and at the narrowest sufficient scope, which is a condition of validity rather than an aspiration, and then to submit that authorisation for ratification by the ordinary body the moment it can act. What a declaration must carry — naming the hazard, the territory, the affected people, and each power relied on, justifying each power separately against that hazard, published reasons and the evidence relied on, immediate notification to the Assembly and to the Constitutional Court, and a fresh source-bound temporal contract for the declaration and separately for each renewal, with each measure rejoining the exact declaration version it relies on rather than a compact status tag — is owed by whoever declares. This route does not acquire the declaring power by standing in for the authoriser, because the requirement it stands inside is that no body declares and exercises alone; no source allocates the declaring power to it, and the card records that silence rather than filling it.
    - *delegation boundary* — This route may not become the predeclared independent substitute reviewer, may not review what it authorised, and may not create a continuing authority that outlives the declaration it belongs to. It may not use procedural acceleration to install a reviewer over its own authorisation either: the independent substitute reviewer is itself predeclared and named in advance, and the general separation rule refuses one actor asserting decisive case facts, deciding their consequence, executing the result, auditing itself, and supplying the final remedy in the same case. The three powers the economic ruling reserved stay outside it: rationing is not a new power but an instance of the ratified physical-scarcity allocation contract, compulsory continuity binds a provider or bargaining party and may not conscript a named worker, and price control is ordinary economic law available to the Assembly at any time so that a declaration adds nothing there.
    - *conflict and recusal* — Two walls apply directly: cross-branch authorisation, so that no body declares and exercises alone, and the general separation rule that no actor may assert decisive case facts, decide their consequence, execute the result, audit itself, and supply the final remedy in the same case. Beyond them the controlling ruling supplies no recusal rule for whoever is predeclared on this route, so the general requirement that every office carry conflict and recusal rules governs, and this card records the absent doctrine rather than writing one.
    - *appointment* — Predeclaration is the appointing act, and the controlling ruling supplies no selector, seat allocation, or qualification route for it; the ratified appointments contract is the only source — open nominations, reasoned qualification review, divided appointing sources, and staggered, nonrenewable mandates — and future body cards must make both direct and de facto appointment control observable and allocate the exact seats, selectors, and qualification authority. The price is printed rather than hidden: a predeclared alternate is itself a route that can be captured, and naming it in advance is the only protection this design offers against that.
    - *removal* — No removal cause for whoever is predeclared on this route appears in the controlling ruling, so the general appointments contract governs: mandates are staggered and nonrenewable, and removal is for stated cause after independent fact-finding and cross-body confirmation. That silence is recorded rather than supplied. What the ruling does supply is the narrower end that matters most here — an alternate authorisation the ordinary body does not ratify at its first opportunity ends, which ends the authorisation rather than the office.
    - *succession* — This route is itself the succession device the emergency section supplies: no required reviewer may turn silence into approval, no unavailable writer or reviewer may obtain a permanent withholding veto, and every consequential route needs a predeclared alternate or escalation path with the same limits and independent review. Neither absence becomes approval and neither becomes an indefinite hold, and the cost of the other choice is stated in the ruling rather than hidden: a constitution that refuses the alternate has chosen a different failure, a lawful response that cannot begin.
    - *temporal status* — A fresh source-bound temporal contract is required for the declaration and separately for each renewal, with each measure rejoining the exact declaration version it relies on rather than a compact status tag; each of the declaration, each renewal, and each individual measure needs its own contract and its own adversarial cases. The case-bound custody contract cannot be reused or borrowed by implication and the custody-only path may not be borrowed as an office term or an election clock, so nothing here inherits a clock from anywhere else.
    - *public reason duty* — Published reasons and the evidence relied on are conditions of a valid declaration, notification to the Assembly and to the Constitutional Court is immediate, and the end triggers a mandatory public post-hoc audit and an accounting of every requisition and restriction. A managed departure is a failure rather than a success: where a response cannot meet an existing duty the shortfall is recorded as a breach, mitigated, and repaired, and it is never renamed as compliance.
    - *anti capture* — Predeclaration is the anti-capture device and its price is stated rather than hidden: a predeclared alternate is itself a route that can be captured, and naming it in advance is the only protection this design offers against that. The surrounding walls are the refusal of any standing emergency authority in the Executive Council, the Civic President, or any protective body; cross-branch authorisation, so that no body declares and exercises alone; ratification at the ordinary body's first opportunity; and the ratified incompatibility rule, under which divided appointing sources alone do not prove concentration absent.
- Accountability routes:
    - *political-accountability* (FS-BOD-02, FS-ROL-25, FS-ROL-26) — Immediate notification to the Assembly and to the Constitutional Court is a condition of a valid declaration, and an alternate authorisation is subject to immediate ratification by the ordinary body the moment it can act: one that the ordinary body does not ratify at its first opportunity ends. Neither absence becomes approval and neither becomes an indefinite hold, so this route is answerable to the body it stood in for rather than to itself.
    - *review* (FS-BOD-17, FS-BOD-18, FS-BOD-37, FS-ROL-34, FS-ROL-58) — Judicial review reaches both the existence of the emergency and each individual measure, is available to any affected person and to the rights advocate, and is not deferred until the emergency ends. Where the ordinary reviewer is unavailable, conflicted, or captured, the predeclared independent substitute reviewer holds that route rather than this one; ordinary courts give case-specific relief and the Constitutional Court alone gives final general invalidation.
    - *audit* (FS-BOD-19, FS-ROL-27, FS-ROL-40) — The end triggers a mandatory public post-hoc audit, an accounting of every requisition and restriction, and a remedy route for harms caused by lawful as well as unlawful measures. Every protective function requires an independent oversight body with its own appointment under the ratified anti-capture contract, its own budget and staff, full access, publication power, and a defined action duty, and the endpoint is stated rather than obscured: implementation may not upgrade a specification into an assurance.
    - *challenge* (FS-BOD-17, FS-BOD-20, FS-ROL-34, FS-ROL-37) — Initiation routes are plural: the affected person, a chosen supporter, a qualified association, and the rights advocate or ombud may each initiate independently, and none requires another to be present. Every protective record, including a declaration and each renewal, names its authorised writer, permitted basis, independent reader, reasons, challenge route, correction, carry, end condition, alternate route, continuity, remedy, audit, and failure polarity, so what a person must contest is on the record rather than in an official's recollection.
- Individualized adverse determinations: enumerated — An authorisation issued on this route is what makes an individual measure lawful, so appeal and remedy attach to each named authorisation below and never to the office as such; no general right of appeal against being predeclared is created here. Judicial review of each measure is available to any affected person and to the rights advocate and is not deferred until the emergency ends, and the remedy route covers harms caused by lawful as well as unlawful measures.
    - **Authorisation of a hazard-specific restriction on a named person or group** against a person whose movement, assembly, or activity a measure on this authorisation restricts. Appeal: Every restriction against the named hazard must be temporary, reviewable, and separately justified against that hazard, and judicial review reaches both the existence of the emergency and that individual measure, is available to any affected person and to the rights advocate, and is not deferred until the emergency ends. Ordinary courts give case-specific relief and the Constitutional Court alone gives final general invalidation. Remedy: The end restores every suspended-in-fact arrangement and triggers a remedy route for harms caused by lawful as well as unlawful measures; remedies are individual and systemic — relief for the person, and re-audit, redesign, recurrence monitoring, and non-repetition measures for the pattern — and no remedy may take another person's standing, floor, core liberty, due process, or political equality.
    - **Requisition of property necessary to the response** against an owner or holder whose property is temporarily used or acquired under the authorisation. Appeal: Requisition is lawful only as temporary use or acquisition of property necessary to the response, with reasons, record, return or compensation, and challenge, and the narrowest sufficient scope is a condition of validity rather than an aspiration. Judicial review reaches the measure itself and is not deferred until the emergency ends. Remedy: What is owed is return or compensation on the terms the requisition power itself carries, together with the accounting of every requisition and restriction that the end of a declaration triggers, and a remedy route for harms caused by lawful as well as unlawful measures. No remedy may take another person's standing, floor, core liberty, due process, or political equality.
    - **Temporary substitution of a decision-maker under procedural acceleration** against a person whose claim, case, or entitlement is decided by a substituted decision-maker on shortened steps. Appeal: Procedural acceleration is available only provided every substantive protection, evidence rule, and appeal survives, so the ordinary appeal against the accelerated decision is preserved rather than compressed away, and the ordinary grounds and review, the identification-and-reasons duty, and access to legal advice and to a court are non-derogable throughout. The substitution may not reach the reviewer of this route's own authorisation, because the independent substitute reviewer is itself predeclared and named in advance. Judicial review reaches the measure and is not deferred until the emergency ends. Remedy: Where acceleration cannot meet an existing duty, the shortfall is recorded as a breach, mitigated, and repaired, and it is never renamed as compliance; the remedy route covers harms caused by lawful as well as unlawful measures, and relief for the person travels with re-audit, redesign, recurrence monitoring, and non-repetition for the pattern.
- Temporal contract (predeclared alternate emergency authorisation, bound separately for the declaration, each renewal, and each measure; custody T3 not-reusable): A fresh source-bound temporal contract is required for the declaration and separately for each renewal, and each measure rejoins the exact declaration version it relies on rather than a compact status tag; the declaration, each renewal, and each individual measure each need their own contract and their own adversarial cases. The case-bound custody contract cannot be reused or borrowed by implication, and the custody-only path may not be borrowed as an office term or an election clock.
    - Failure polarity: Current restrictive authority is a positive premise: absent current, authenticated, source-bound renewal evidence in a fresh evaluation, the restrictive power has no current legal effect, and the polarity is the same as the existing custody gate rather than a novel shape. Its absence withholds the restrictive conclusion and derives no opposite fact, because cessation is a positive recorded act or a fresh-evaluation claim and is never derived from silence. What that buys is stated plainly: it defeats a renewal that was never made, it does not defeat a frozen or replayed record, and Book 1 cannot make an emergency end — it can withhold current legal effect from an unrenewed power and it cannot cause anyone to act.
    - Expiry default: An alternate authorisation the ordinary body does not ratify at its first opportunity ends, and missing, withheld, stale, disputed, or corrected evidence never extends a restrictive power and never cuts off a claimant's floor, liberty, appeal, or remedy. The floor and essential-service continuity survive the lapse of the managing authority: that is the source-bound default this card chooses, because it preserves essential claimant continuity without preserving ordinary incumbent power.
- Delegated mechanics (bounded, never an invented value):
    - Who is predeclared on this route, by what instrument, and through which selectors is reserved: the ruling requires only that the route be named in advance, and it writes no seat, selector, qualification body, or number, so this card fixes the constraints and not the choice. Choice owner: constitutional implementation inside the ratified sources, anti-capture rules, democratic corridor, continuity defaults, and prohibitions, with any choice outside those limits returning for a new author ruling Bounds: the route must be named in advance, bound by every limit in the emergency section, and separate from the predeclared independent substitute reviewer; appointment follows open nominations, reasoned qualification review, divided appointing sources, and staggered nonrenewable mandates; and no standing emergency authority may be created in the Executive Council, the Civic President, or any protective body Failure default: with no predeclared route named, no alternate authorisation has current legal effect, and the absence is neither approval nor an indefinite hold; the floor and essential-service continuity survive
    - What counts as the ordinary body's first opportunity is reserved to constitutional implementation and is written as a condition rather than a duration: the sources fix that ratification is immediate the moment the ordinary body can act and that an unratified authorisation ends, and they supply no clock, calendar, or interval, which Book 1 could not advance in any case. Choice owner: constitutional implementation inside the ratified sources, anti-capture rules, democratic corridor, continuity defaults, and prohibitions, with any choice outside those limits returning for a new author ruling Bounds: ratification is owed at the ordinary body's first opportunity; neither absence becomes approval nor an indefinite hold; and no implementation may convert the waiting period into a continuing power Failure default: an authorisation not ratified at the first opportunity ends, and absent current authenticated renewal evidence the restrictive power has no current legal effect while the claimant's floor, appeal, and remedy continue
- Book 2 handoff: Book 2 owns operation under declared shock conditions: incident command, stockpiles, disaster logistics, continuity planning, infrastructure restoration, notification and publication systems, staffing, costs, capacity, and empirical feasibility, together with the independently witnessed sources that distinguish a live renewal from a frozen or replayed one and the assurance that an outside clock advances, that a required record arrives, and that a reviewer actually acts. Book 1 specifies the contract; it cannot make an emergency end.

#### FS-BOD-37 — Emergency independent substitute reviewer (predeclared-substitute-reviewer)

- Applicability: the ordinary emergency reviewer being unavailable, conflicted, or captured
- Status: ratified-unimplemented narrow function; severity critical; consequence: emergency independent substitute reviewer absent or fused with an incompatible function
- Owner: `new-book-plans/book-1-constitutional-coverage-map.md::Maintain completed constitutional coverage rows`; closure: the owning source-family power cards and allocations remain complete and source-bound
- Status senses:
    - *universal human standing* — Emergency is an overlay that suspends nothing, so the review this route conducts is review inside unchanged substantive protections rather than review of what may be set aside: a declaration confers no power to derogate from any categorical refusal or to lower the material floor. Reviewing confers no personhood and removes none, and formal implementation must keep universal human standing separate from political membership, franchise, candidacy, current office, current lawful power, and permanent historical public answerability.
    - *political membership* — Ordinary residence creates political membership and a review function neither creates nor removes it; registration records evidence of membership rather than creating it, and a declaration confers no power to alter the franchise. A person who appears in a review file is a person the record holds something about, never a person whose membership the file may be read to withdraw.
    - *franchise* — A declaration confers no power to postpone or cancel an election, to extend any mandate, or to alter the franchise, and the ordinary franchise is non-derogable, which no declaration suspends or postpones. Nothing in a review decision may weight, condition, suspend, or substitute a ballot, and the continued existence and capacity to sit of the People's Assembly and the Constitutional Court sits inside the unamendable corridor beyond the reach of anything reviewed here.
    - *candidacy* — No decision supplies an express candidacy incompatibility for whoever is predeclared as substitute reviewer, so the adult-resident baseline governs unchanged and the silence is recorded rather than filled. The express separation the sources do supply is functional rather than electoral: the predeclared alternate authorising route and the predeclared independent substitute reviewer are two named routes, not one, and the ratified incompatibility rule addresses majority appointment control of a court or independent oversight body rather than who may stand for election.
    - *current office* — What occupancy consists of here is being named in advance and remaining independent: the route is predeclared and bound by every limit in the emergency section. The condition on which it is reached is carried by two ratified sentences rather than one, and both are recorded instead of a third being written: the emergency ruling's own stated case is that the authorising body cannot convene, while the phrase this card is keyed to — the ordinary reviewer being unavailable, conflicted, or captured — belongs to the Future Conditions Guardian's separately predeclared independent substitute reviewer, the route the emergency section adopts as its settlement. A certified successor immediately ends the predecessor's current authority, and a refusal to acknowledge that certification, transfer records, or leave office does not extend the mandate.
    - *current lawful power* — Authority to review is a positive premise carried by the exact declaration version and measure before it, and the polarity is the same as the existing custody gate — current authority is a positive premise, and its absence withholds the restrictive conclusion, deriving no opposite fact. A review not conducted is therefore not an approval: neither absence becomes approval and neither becomes an indefinite hold, and cessation is a positive recorded act or a fresh-evaluation claim rather than an inference from silence.
    - *permanent historical public answerability* — Answerability for what was reviewed and on what reasons survives every removal, reorganisation, and renaming of a body, and no immunity, indemnity, classification, statute of repose, amnesty, or pardon may extinguish accountability for a categorically refused act. The end of a declaration triggers a mandatory public post-hoc audit and an accounting of every requisition and restriction, so the historical record outlasts the authority, while current office and current lawful power do end.
- Office contract:
    - *democratic source* — The source is the ratified settlement applied to a blocked review: a predeclared alternate authorising route and a predeclared independent substitute reviewer, both named in advance, both bound by every limit in the emergency section, and both subject to immediate ratification by the ordinary body the moment it can act. The need arises because a cross-branch authorisation requirement hands whoever can prevent the ordinary bodies from convening a veto over every lawful response.
    - *jurisdiction* — The reach is exactly the ordinary review's reach and no wider: judicial review reaches both the existence of the emergency and each individual measure, is available to any affected person and to the rights advocate, and is not deferred until the emergency ends. This route gives no general invalidation — ordinary courts give case-specific relief and the Constitutional Court alone gives final general invalidation — and it is bound by every limit in the emergency section rather than holding a reach of its own.
    - *ordinary function* — The ordinary job of a predeclared substitute reviewer is to be predeclared, independent of the authorising and executing functions, and reachable, and never to be the authoriser: on an ordinary day the route holds nothing to exercise, and being already named is the whole of it. The condition that brings it into use is recorded at both of its ratified sources rather than merged into one — the emergency ruling names the case where the authorising body cannot convene, and the Guardian route it adopts names the ordinary reviewer being unavailable, conflicted, or captured. In either case the job is the same review under identical limits — reaching both the existence of the emergency and each individual measure, working from the published reasons and the evidence relied on and from each measure's rejoining of the exact declaration version rather than a compact status tag, hearing any affected person and the rights advocate, and not deferring until the emergency ends — with the outcome recorded and the measure withheld rather than assumed where the required premise is absent.
    - *delegation boundary* — This route may not authorise what it reviews, may not become the predeclared alternate authorising route, may not extend a measure, and may not become an indefinite hold; no required reviewer may turn silence into approval. The general separation rule applies without modification: no actor may assert decisive case facts, decide their consequence, execute the result, audit itself, and supply the final remedy in the same case.
    - *conflict and recusal* — Independence from the authorising and executing functions is the reason this route exists at all, and it may not review what it authorised because it authorises nothing. The disqualifications the trigger names are borrowed rather than invented: the Guardian route the emergency section adopts reaches its separately predeclared independent substitute reviewer where the ordinary reviewer is unavailable, conflicted, or captured, while the emergency ruling's own stated case is that the authorising body cannot convene. Beyond that and the general separation rule — no actor may assert decisive case facts, decide their consequence, execute the result, audit itself, and supply the final remedy in the same case — the controlling ruling supplies no recusal rule for whoever is predeclared here, so the general requirement that every office carry conflict and recusal rules governs, and this card records the absent doctrine rather than writing one.
    - *appointment* — Predeclaration is the appointing act, and the controlling ruling supplies no selector, seat allocation, or qualification route for it; the ratified appointments contract is the only source — open nominations, reasoned qualification review, divided appointing sources, and staggered, nonrenewable mandates — and future body cards must make both direct and de facto appointment control observable and allocate the exact seats, selectors, and qualification authority. The printed price of predeclaration applies here too: a predeclared route is itself a route that can be captured, and naming it in advance is the only protection this design offers.
    - *removal* — No removal cause for whoever is predeclared as substitute reviewer appears in the controlling ruling, so the general appointments contract governs: mandates are staggered and nonrenewable, and removal is for stated cause after independent fact-finding and cross-body confirmation. That silence is recorded rather than supplied, and the ruling's own end condition is narrower and different in kind — the route ceases to be the reviewer when the ordinary reviewer can act again, which ends the substitution rather than the office.
    - *succession* — This route is itself the escalation path the no-silence rule requires: no required reviewer may turn silence into approval, no unavailable writer or reviewer may obtain a permanent withholding veto, and every consequential route needs a predeclared alternate or escalation path with the same limits and independent review. A vacancy here withholds the substitute review and derives no opposite fact — neither absence becomes approval and neither becomes an indefinite hold — while absent current, authenticated, source-bound renewal evidence in a fresh evaluation the restrictive power has no current legal effect and the claimant's floor, liberty, appeal, and remedy continue as duties owed. Where both the ordinary reviewer and this route are unavailable the ruling supplies no further escalation, and the card records that gap rather than writing one.
    - *temporal status* — The declaration, each renewal, and each individual measure each need their own source-bound contract and their own adversarial cases, and each measure rejoins the exact declaration version it relies on rather than a compact status tag, so a review is bound to the exact version before it. The case-bound custody contract cannot be reused or borrowed by implication and the custody-only path may not be borrowed as an office term or an election clock.
    - *public reason duty* — The controlling ruling states no publication sentence specific to this reviewer, and this card records that rather than inventing one: the duty is inherited, because the predeclared routes are bound by every limit in the emergency section, and those limits require published reasons and the evidence relied on for a declaration and make judicial review of both the emergency's existence and each measure available and undeferred. The general office contract supplies the rest — every office owes a public-reason duty — and nothing beyond those inherited limits is asserted here.
    - *anti capture* — Independence from the authorising and executing functions is the design's anti-capture device here, together with the refusal of any standing emergency authority in the Executive Council, the Civic President, or any protective body, and the requirement that no body declares and exercises alone. The price is stated rather than hidden: a predeclared route is itself capturable, and naming it in advance is the only protection offered; the ratified incompatibility rule adds that majority appointment control of a court or independent oversight body is a legal incompatibility while divided sources alone do not prove concentration absent.
- Accountability routes:
    - *review* (FS-BOD-18, FS-ROL-34, FS-ROL-40) — A substitute review is not a final word, and what checks it is named narrowly rather than by pointing back at the route it stands in for. The Constitutional Court alone gives final general invalidation, and its continued existence and capacity to sit sits inside the unamendable corridor, so that route is not the one this function substitutes into. The emergency ruling does not name which body ordinarily holds the review this function takes over, and this card records that gap rather than assigning it; the entitlement itself is fixed either way, since judicial review reaching both the existence of the emergency and each individual measure is owed to any affected person and to the rights advocate and is not deferred until the emergency ends.
    - *challenge* (FS-BOD-17, FS-BOD-20, FS-ROL-34, FS-ROL-37) — Initiation routes are plural: the affected person, a chosen supporter, a qualified association, and the rights advocate or ombud may each initiate independently, and none requires another to be present. Every protective record, including a declaration and each renewal, names its authorised writer, permitted basis, independent reader, reasons, challenge route, correction, carry, end condition, alternate route, continuity, remedy, audit, and failure polarity, so what a person contests before this reviewer is on the record rather than in an official's recollection.
    - *audit* (FS-BOD-19, FS-ROL-27, FS-ROL-40) — The end of a declaration triggers a mandatory public post-hoc audit and an accounting of every requisition and restriction, which reaches what was reviewed and what was allowed to stand. Every protective function requires an independent oversight body with its own appointment under the ratified anti-capture contract, its own budget and staff, full access, publication power, and a defined action duty, and the endpoint is stated rather than obscured: implementation may not upgrade a specification into an assurance.
    - *political-accountability* (none named) — No political-accountability checker is named for this route, and the absence is stated rather than left blank: the ruling makes both predeclared routes subject to immediate ratification by the ordinary body the moment it can act and supplies no political checker over a reviewer, and a reviewer politically reachable by the authoriser whose measure it reviews would not be the independent substitute the settlement names. What carries the accountability instead is the mandatory public post-hoc audit and accounting the end of a declaration triggers, the plural initiation routes beside it, and the rule that neither absence becomes approval and neither becomes an indefinite hold.
- Individualized adverse determinations: enumerated — A review decision that lets a restriction stand is adverse to the person it binds, so appeal and remedy attach to each named decision below and never to the office as such; no general right of appeal against being the substitute reviewer is created here. This route may not authorise what it reviews, may not extend a measure, and may not become an indefinite hold, and no required reviewer may turn silence into approval, so an undecided review is neither an adverse determination nor a permission.
    - **Review decision leaving a hazard-specific restriction in force against a named person** against a person whose movement, assembly, or activity a reviewed measure restricts. Appeal: The entitlement is undeferred rather than exhausted: judicial review reaching both the existence of the emergency and that individual measure is owed to any affected person and to the rights advocate and is not deferred until the emergency ends, and every restriction must in any case be temporary, reviewable, and separately justified against the named hazard. What does not depend on any reviewer being able to sit is the fail-safe polarity — current restrictive authority is a positive premise, and absent current, authenticated, source-bound renewal evidence in a fresh evaluation the restrictive power has no current legal effect — while what the corridor protects is the continued existence and capacity to sit of the Constitutional Court, which alone gives final general invalidation. Where this route too is unavailable the ruling names no further forum, and the card records that rather than inventing one. Remedy: The end restores every suspended-in-fact arrangement and carries a remedy route for harms caused by lawful as well as unlawful measures; remedies are individual and systemic — relief for the person, and re-audit, redesign, recurrence monitoring, and non-repetition measures for the pattern — and no remedy may take another person's standing, floor, core liberty, due process, or political equality.
    - **Review decision leaving a requisition or its accounting undisturbed** against an owner or holder whose property was temporarily used or acquired under a reviewed measure. Appeal: Requisition carries reasons, record, return or compensation, and challenge as conditions of the power itself rather than as a favour of whoever reviews it, so a review that leaves the measure undisturbed dissolves none of them, and judicial review of the measure is owed to any affected person and to the rights advocate and is not deferred until the emergency ends. The Constitutional Court alone gives final general invalidation and its continued existence and capacity to sit sits inside the unamendable corridor, and absent current, authenticated, source-bound renewal evidence in a fresh evaluation the restrictive power has no current legal effect at all. Remedy: What is owed is return or compensation on the terms the requisition power carries, the accounting of every requisition and restriction that the end of a declaration triggers, and a remedy route for harms caused by lawful as well as unlawful measures. Relief for the person travels with re-audit, redesign, recurrence monitoring, and non-repetition for the pattern, and no remedy may take another person's standing, floor, core liberty, due process, or political equality.
- Temporal contract (predeclared substitute review authority, bound separately to the declaration, each renewal, and each reviewed measure; custody T3 not-reusable): The declaration, each renewal, and each individual measure each need their own source-bound contract and their own adversarial cases, and a review binds to the exact declaration version the measure rejoins rather than to a compact status tag, so authority to review one measure is never authority over another. The case-bound custody contract cannot be reused or borrowed by implication, and the custody-only path may not be borrowed as an office term or an election clock.
    - Failure polarity: Current restrictive authority is a positive premise: absent current, authenticated, source-bound renewal evidence in a fresh evaluation, the restrictive power has no current legal effect, and the polarity is the same as the existing custody gate rather than a novel shape — its absence withholds the restrictive conclusion and derives no opposite fact. Silence on this route decides nothing in either direction: neither absence becomes approval, neither becomes an indefinite hold, and cessation is a positive recorded act or a fresh-evaluation claim rather than an inference from silence.
    - Expiry default: Expiry ends the substitution and never the claimant. Where the ordinary reviewer can act again, the undeferred entitlement to judicial review of both the emergency's existence and each individual measure is that reviewer's to discharge; where this route's own authority lapses instead, missing, withheld, stale, disputed, or corrected evidence never extends a restrictive power and never cuts off a claimant's floor, liberty, appeal, or remedy, and the floor and essential-service continuity survive the lapse of the managing authority. That is the source-bound default this card chooses, preserving essential claimant continuity without preserving ordinary incumbent power.
- Delegated mechanics (bounded, never an invented value):
    - Who is predeclared as substitute reviewer, by what instrument, and through which selectors is reserved: the ruling requires only that the reviewer be named in advance and be independent, and it writes no seat, selector, qualification body, or number, so this card fixes the constraints and not the choice. Choice owner: constitutional implementation inside the ratified sources, anti-capture rules, democratic corridor, continuity defaults, and prohibitions, with any choice outside those limits returning for a new author ruling Bounds: the reviewer must be named in advance, independent of the authorising and executing functions, separate from the predeclared alternate authorising route, and bound by every limit in the emergency section; appointment follows open nominations, reasoned qualification review, divided appointing sources, and staggered nonrenewable mandates Failure default: with no substitute reviewer named, no substitute review has current legal effect, and the absence is neither approval of a measure nor an indefinite hold; absent current, authenticated, source-bound renewal evidence the restrictive power has no current legal effect either, and the claimant's floor, appeal, and remedy continue as duties owed; the ruling supplies no second substitute where this route is itself unavailable, and that gap is recorded rather than filled
- Book 2 handoff: Book 2 owns the operation of review under declared shock conditions: case administration, evidence handling, hearing and participation logistics, accessible publication and notification systems, records and archives, staffing, costs, capacity, and empirical feasibility, together with the independently witnessed sources that distinguish a live renewal from a frozen or replayed one and the assurance that an outside clock advances, that a required record arrives, and that a reviewer actually acts. Book 1 specifies the reviewing contract and cannot cause a review to happen.

#### FS-BOD-38 — Border, removal, and transfer execution administration (administration)

- Applicability: a final individual border, expulsion, extradition, surrender, transfer, or return decision after suspensive appeal
- Status: ratified-unimplemented narrow function; severity critical; consequence: border, removal, and transfer execution administration absent or fused with an incompatible function
- Owner: `new-book-plans/book-1-constitutional-coverage-map.md::Maintain completed constitutional coverage rows`; closure: the owning source-family power cards and allocations remain complete and source-bound
- Status senses:
    - *universal human standing* — Every person within the republic's jurisdiction or effective control is owed standing, the material floor, due process, and an effective remedy regardless of citizenship, nationality, immigration classification, documentation, manner of entry, or the absence of any record, and a final decision against that person changes none of it. Formal implementation must keep universal human standing separate from political membership, franchise, candidacy, current office, current lawful power, and permanent historical public answerability, and handing a person over is a coercive act by this republic to which every limit on arrest, detention, and force attaches.
    - *political membership* — Ordinary residence creates political membership and an execution function neither creates nor removes it; registration records evidence of membership and does not create membership, so an execution file is evidence about a person and may never be read back as an absence of membership. Serve first and reconcile the record afterwards; no record found reads as pending, never as denied.
    - *franchise* — Executing a decision may not weight, condition, suspend, or substitute a ballot. Every adult ordinary resident has one political home at each applicable tier, and the ordinary franchise is among the protections no declaration suspends or postpones, so a pending removal touches neither the register of an unaffected resident nor the vote of the person concerned while they remain one.
    - *candidacy* — No decision supplies an express candidacy incompatibility for a holder of this execution function, so the adult-resident baseline governs unchanged and the silence is recorded rather than filled. The ratified incompatibility rule addresses majority appointment control by one government, chamber, party coalition, profession, or appointing source, and it speaks to appointment control rather than to who may stand for election.
    - *current office* — Occupancy of this office is a positive, certifiable fact: a certified successor immediately ends the predecessor's current authority, and the outgoing holder's refusal to acknowledge that certification, transfer records, or leave office does not extend the mandate. An unexecuted decision in hand extends nothing either, and it confers no authority the decision itself did not carry.
    - *current lawful power* — Authority to execute is a positive premise carried by an exact final individual decision, and the polarity is the same as the existing custody gate — current authority is a positive premise, and its absence withholds the restrictive conclusion. That absence derives no opposite fact: it establishes neither that a removal was lawful, nor that one occurred, nor that a person was released.
    - *permanent historical public answerability* — Answerability for a coercive act done to a named person survives every removal, reorganisation, and renaming of a body, and no immunity, indemnity, classification, statute of repose, amnesty, or pardon may extinguish accountability for a categorically refused act. The provenance required to audit official action and the permanent historical public answerability of office-holders are protected apart from any current mandate, while current office and current lawful power do end.
- Office contract:
    - *democratic source* — The common tier owns borders, entry, asylum determination, expulsion, extradition, and mutual legal assistance, and that competence addition creates no general security, foreign-affairs, policing, or emergency power. This function holds no self-originating authority at all: it acts on an individual decision it did not make, and surrender, extradition, transfer, or handover of any person requires an individual judicial decision as its source.
    - *jurisdiction* — The reach is exactly the exact final individual decision in hand and no further. Everyone within the republic's jurisdiction or effective control is owed the protections that bound it, effective control rather than formal territory is the test, and non-refoulement follows the person directly or through a chain of onward transfers, so a handover does not end this republic's duty at the point of transfer. Several of the limits on this card's check-line are categorical rather than limits on acting alone, and this card says so because the check-line phrasing could be read as implying a joint route: non-refoulement is absolute, collective expulsion is refused and sits inside the unamendable corridor, no child is detained for an immigration purpose, and an expulsion requires an effective appeal with suspensive effect — no second body's concurrence dispenses with any of them.
    - *ordinary function* — The ordinary act is bounded execution of one exact final decision: confirming that the decision in hand is the decision that was made, that its appeal with suspensive effect is spent, that no absolute bar is engaged, and that the person's floor, family and child protections, and records travel with them — then writing the execution record that names its authorised writer, basis, reader, reasons, challenge route, correction, carry, end condition, continuity, and remedy. Where the decision cannot be matched or a bar is engaged, the ordinary act is to withhold execution rather than proceed, because handing a person over is a coercive act by this republic and every limit on arrest, detention, and force attaches to it.
    - *delegation boundary* — Nothing here may be outsourced: pushbacks, interception designed to prevent a claim from arising, externalised processing arranged so that the duty attaches to nobody, transfer to a state that will do what the republic may not, and jurisdiction-shopping through agreements, contractors, or funding do not relieve the republic of a duty it would otherwise owe. Mutual legal assistance may not be used to obtain, launder, or receive material the republic could not lawfully obtain itself, nor to transmit material that would enable a categorically refused act, and this function may not determine the claim it executes.
    - *conflict and recusal* — The separating rule is the general one, applied without modification: no actor may assert decisive case facts, decide their consequence, execute the result, audit itself, and supply the final remedy in the same case, and no institution may assert the decisive facts of its own legitimacy and then decide them. Beyond that the ruling supplies no execution-officer recusal rule, so the general office contract governs — every office must have conflict and recusal rules — and this card records the absent doctrine rather than writing one.
    - *appointment* — The controlling ruling supplies no appointment machinery for this execution function, and its protective-oversight appointment sentence binds the independent oversight body rather than the administration that body examines. This is ordinary public administration executing an individual decision it did not make rather than a predeclared independent office, so the ratified contract for independent appointments — open nominations, reasoned qualification review, divided appointing sources, staggered and nonrenewable mandates — is cited here as the nearest ratified pattern and expressly not as this body's rule, and the anti-capture appointment machinery is deliberately not imported for it. What governs instead is the general requirement that every office have a democratic or legal source, mandate, jurisdiction, delegation boundary, conflict and recusal rules, finite end condition, successor, review route, and public-reason duty, while future body cards must make both direct and de facto appointment control observable and allocate the exact seats, selectors, and qualification authority. The gap is recorded, not filled.
    - *removal* — No removal cause for this office appears in the controlling ruling, and none is written here. The rule that mandates are staggered and nonrenewable and that removal is for stated cause after independent fact-finding and cross-body confirmation is written for independent appointments rather than for ordinary administration, so it is cited as the nearest ratified pattern and not as this body's rule; the qualifying causes for an execution office are enumerated nowhere and that silence is recorded rather than supplied. What no removal carries away with it is the answerability: no immunity, indemnity, classification, statute of repose, amnesty, or pardon may extinguish accountability for a categorically refused act, and answerability survives every removal, reorganisation, and renaming of a body.
    - *succession* — A successor, a review route, and a finite end condition are owed of every office, and the no-silence rule applies with one asymmetry worth stating: no required reviewer may turn silence into approval and no unavailable reviewer may obtain a permanent withholding veto, but an unavailable executor never converts into authority to proceed without the decision. A vacancy withholds the execution power while the person's owed floor, due process, and remedy stay untouched.
    - *temporal status* — Each of the following needs its own source-bound contract and its own adversarial cases: the border hold, the expulsion stay, and the transfer. The case-bound custody contract cannot be reused or borrowed by implication and the custody-only path may not be borrowed as an office term or an election clock, so this function's mandate and each act it executes carry separate sources; the retained custody record belongs to the custodial executor and not here.
    - *public reason duty* — The decision executed must already carry its individual reasons and its spent suspensive appeal, and this function owes its own record: every protective record — border decision, expulsion, transfer, detention — names its authorised writer, permitted basis, visibility and privacy boundary, independent reader, reasons, challenge route, correction, retention and deletion control, carry, end condition, alternate route, continuity, remedy, audit, and failure polarity. Absence of a record is never proof that a coercive act did not happen and never a defence for the actor who should have written it, and no secret law, secret court, or secret detention site is available here.
    - *anti capture* — The ratified incompatibility rule names majority appointment control of a court or independent oversight body rather than an administration, and this card records that reach limit rather than stretching it; divided sources alone do not prove concentration absent. The wall that binds directly is the no-evasion rule read with the separation rule: an execution function may not acquire through a contractor, a funding arrangement, or a foreign partner the authority it may not hold itself, and it may not audit or finally remedy its own act.
- Accountability routes:
    - *challenge* (FS-BOD-17, FS-ROL-32, FS-ROL-34) — The appeal is a precondition rather than an afterthought: an expulsion requires an individual decision, reasons, and an effective appeal with suspensive effect, and a surrender, extradition, transfer, or handover requires an individual judicial decision, disclosed reasons, and an effective appeal with suspensive effect before anything is executed. Ordinary courts provide relief in individual cases, and the affected person, a chosen supporter, a qualified association, and the rights advocate or ombud may each initiate independently.
    - *review* (FS-BOD-18, FS-BOD-20, FS-ROL-32, FS-ROL-37) — Prompt independent judicial review of detention sits inside the unamendable corridor together with non-refoulement and the prohibition of collective expulsion, so any holding incident to execution is reviewable on that footing. The Constitutional Court alone gives final general invalidation, which keeps case-specific relief and generally applicable invalidation in different hands.
    - *audit* (FS-BOD-19, FS-ROL-27, FS-ROL-40) — Every protective function requires an independent oversight body with its own appointment under the ratified anti-capture contract, its own budget and staff, full access, publication power, and a defined action duty, plus an independent integrity route that does not run through the abuser's own chain of command, with non-recording, destruction, or falsification of evidence of its own coercive acts treated as a substantive failure and not a procedural one. The endpoint is stated rather than obscured, and implementation may not upgrade a specification into an assurance.
    - *political-accountability* (FS-BOD-02, FS-ROL-25, FS-ROL-26) — The common tier's ownership of borders, entry, asylum determination, expulsion, extradition, and mutual legal assistance places answerability for this function with the common legislature, while regional and local tiers retain ordinary policing, civil protection, and residual competence. Other states' cooperation, recognition, readmission, and compliance are named external assumptions, so no political route may treat another state's conduct as this function's achievement or its excuse.
- Individualized adverse determinations: enumerated — Execution is where an already adverse decision reaches a body, so appeal and remedy attach to each named act below and never to the office as such; no general right of appeal against execution is created here, and the appeal against the underlying decision is a precondition of acting rather than a parallel comfort. A diplomatic assurance does not displace an absolute bar; it is evidence, and weak evidence, about what another state will do.
    - **Execution of an expulsion or removal against a named person** against a person whose individual expulsion decision has been made and whose suspensive appeal is spent. Appeal: An expulsion requires an individual decision, reasons, and an effective appeal with suspensive effect, and collective expulsion is refused and sits inside the unamendable corridor; a person's connection to the republic, family life, length of residence, and the position of any child affected are material to every removal decision. Ordinary courts provide relief in individual cases, and this function may not treat an unexhausted appeal as spent.
